description: This file defines a React component 'ImageComponent' for rendering and managing images within the Notesnook editor, including features like resizing, lazy loading, and attachment handling.

methods.name: makeImageQuery
methods.description: Creates a filter function to identify specific image attachments based on src or hash.

methods.name: canParse
methods.description: Checks if a string can be parsed as a valid URL.

methods.name: clampSize
methods.description: Adjusts image size to fit within max width while maintaining aspect ratio.

methods.description: Calculates dimensions to maintain aspect ratio given a width.

methods.description: Returns style object for image alignment based on options.
